# Avante Maps

> Discover local and online businesses that accept Pi Network cryptocurrency. Register your business, find places to spend Pi, and connect with the Pi business community.

Avante Maps is an independent platform built to accelerate Pi Network adoption by mapping businesses that accept Pi as payment. Customers can search, bookmark, review and message businesses; owners can register, manage listings, view analytics, and respond to customers (with a paid plan).

## Pages

- [Home / Map](/): Interactive map of businesses that accept Pi.
- [Recommendations](/recommendations): Curated and top-rated Pi-accepting businesses.
- [Bookmarks](/bookmarks): Your saved favorite businesses.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Subscription plans (Individual, Small Business, Organization) paid in Pi.
- [Register Business](/registration): List your business on Avante Maps.
- [CommuniCon](/communicon): AI assistant and direct messaging with businesses.
- [Notifications](/notifications): Account, business and system notifications.
- [Verification Info](/verification-info): How business verification and certification work.
- [About](/about): Mission, team and the Pi ecosystem.
- [Contact](/contact): Email, phone and contact form.
